name: themis
description: Manages CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md: one skill to create, prune and edit them, and hooks that cap their size and keep the two files identical.

claude_md_cap.title: Rule file token cap
claude_md_cap.description: Maximum estimated tokens for a CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md or AGENTS.md file including its imports. 0 disables the cap.

parity.title: Keep CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md identical
parity.description: Copy every edit of CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md to the other file in the same directory, and report pairs that differ. Turn off to manage only one of the two.
